purpose.zh-Hant: 由方程讀出圓，再處理切線、交點與弦長。
purpose.en: Read a circle from its equation, then study tangency, intersections and chords.

prerequisites.zh-Hant: 完成平方、直線方程、點到直線距離及畢氏定理。
prerequisites.en: Completing the square, line equations, point-to-line distance and Pythagoras’ theorem.

scopeNote.zh-Hant: 本頁提供基本方法導讀及現有題庫入口；進階分支與完整圖解會繼續補充，並非完整課綱或全章筆記。
scopeNote.en: This is a foundational method guide and an entry to the published bank. Advanced branches and complete visual explanations are still being developed; this is not a complete syllabus or chapter note.

intro.zh-Hant: 標準式直接顯示圓心及半徑平方；一般式先完成平方。右邊是半徑平方，不能直接當半徑。
intro.en: The standard form gives the centre and squared radius. Complete the square for a general form. The right-hand side is the squared radius, not the radius.

trigger.zh-Hant: 先完成平方，再檢查半徑平方是否為正。
trigger.en: Complete the square and check whether the squared radius is positive.

trap.zh-Hant: R²=0 是一點；R²<0 沒有實點，不能當成普通圓。
trap.en: R²=0 gives one point; R²<0 has no real points. Neither is an ordinary circle.

title.zh-Hant: 直線與圓：用距離或判別式
title.en: Line and circle: distance or discriminant

intro.zh-Hant: 比較圓心到直線的距離 d 與半徑 R，可判斷相離、相切或相交；要求交點時可聯立方程。
intro.en: Compare the centre-to-line distance d with R to identify no intersection, tangency or two intersections. Solve simultaneous equations when coordinates are needed.

trigger.zh-Hant: 相切題用 d=R，或代入後令二次方程判別式為零；切線垂直於切點半徑。
trigger.en: For tangency use d=R, or substitute and set the quadratic discriminant to zero. A tangent is perpendicular to the radius at contact.

trap.zh-Hant: 距離公式要有絕對值；平方後仍須檢查原本參數及圓是否存在。
trap.en: Keep the absolute value in the distance formula. After squaring, recheck parameters and the existence of the circle.

intro.zh-Hant: 圓心到弦的垂線平分弦。先求圓心到弦所在直線的距離，再用直角三角形關係求半弦長。
intro.en: The perpendicular from the centre bisects a chord. Find the centre-to-line distance, then use a right triangle to obtain the half-chord.

trigger.zh-Hant: 求完整弦長時記得乘 2；軌跡題先翻譯距離條件再化成圓方程。
trigger.en: Double the half-chord for the full length. Translate distance conditions before simplifying a locus to a circle equation.

trap.zh-Hant: d>R 沒有實弦；不要把半弦長當作整條弦長。
trap.en: If d>R there is no real chord. Do not confuse a half-chord with the full chord.
